videoUrl.title: Video URL
videoUrl.description: The URL of the video to download (YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, Reddit, TikTok, Instagram)

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Cookies in Netscape format for authentication (one cookie per line)

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Platform of the video (auto-detected if not specified)

uploadToDrive.title: Upload to Google Drive
uploadToDrive.description: Upload the downloaded video to Google Drive

driveFolderId.title: Google Drive Folder ID
driveFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID to upload the video to (leave empty for root folder)

googleClientId.title: Google Client ID
googleClientId.description: Google OAuth Client ID for Drive API access

googleClientSecret.title: Google Client Secret
googleClientSecret.description: Google OAuth Client Secret for Drive API access

googleRefreshToken.title: Google Refresh Token
googleRefreshToken.description: Google OAuth Refresh Token for Drive API access
